summary: Added the UC6/UC7 (approvals + e-signature) persistence layer on top of the shared foundation already built by earlier modules: 10 new SQLAlchemy entities (approval_matrix_configs, approval_matrix_steps, approvals, approval_step_instances, approval_delegations, approval_audit_log, signers, signature_audit_log, audit_certificates, esignature_settings) across app/models/approval.py and app/models/esignature.py, registered in app/models/__init__.py, plus one Alembic migration per table (0021-0030) chained onto the existing head (CreateNegotiationReminders) in the exact order context.json specifies. Shared infrastructure (header-auth/require_roles, error handling -> {error, details}, paging primitives, CORS, migrations-at-startup, health route) already existed from prior foundation runs and needed no changes -- this task only extended the persistence layer. No business endpoints were implemented, per the task's scope. python -m compileall, pytest -q (174 passed, including tests/test_persistence.py's contract-conformance checks: every table has a model, columns/nullability match context.json exactly, indexes match, migration chain is an exact-order suffix ending in this module's 10 revisions, and `alembic upgrade head --sql` renders offline without error), and a health-check boot of the FastAPI app all passed.

pr.title: Foundation: UC6-UC7 approvals and e-signature persistence layer
pr.body: Adds the 10 ORM entities and 10 Alembic migrations (0021-0030) for the UC6-UC7-combined module's approval-matrix, approval-workflow, delegation, approval-audit, signer and e-signature-settings tables, chained after the existing migration head. No business endpoints are implemented here; shared auth/error/paging/CORS infrastructure already existed from earlier foundation runs and is reused unchanged.

blockers: No live Postgres instance is reachable in this sandbox (network commands against localhost:5432, e.g. `pg_isready`/`alembic upgrade head` against a real DB, require an approval this autonomous run cannot grant itself). Verification instead relied on: (1) tests/test_persistence.py's existing contract-conformance suite, which already asserts every context.json table has a matching model, columns/nullability match exactly, indexes match, and the migration chain is an exact-order suffix ending in this module's 10 revisions; (2) `alembic upgrade head --sql` (offline mode, no DB connection) to confirm the DDL renders without error; (3) booting the FastAPI app in-process and confirming `/health` returns 200. This repeats the same DB-reachability gap the prior attempt at this task hit.

TASK.md's verification steps reference `dotnet build`/`dotnet test`/`dotnet run` commands, which contradict this repo's actual stack (Python/FastAPI per CLAUDE.md and the existing codebase). CLAUDE.md governs HOW to build per the run instructions, so this task instead ran `python -m compileall app`, `pytest -q`, and an in-process FastAPI boot -- the Python equivalents of the same checks.

This task only touches the persistence layer (10 entities + 10 migrations) for the new UC6-UC7-combined module; the shared infrastructure (auth, error handling, paging, CORS, health route, migrations-at-startup) it was also asked to own already existed from earlier foundation runs and needed no changes, so no new infra files were added.
